description:
What the window is allowed to ask the shell for. Tauri v2 refuses every `plugin:` command that no capability names, and an application defining no capabilities gets an empty allow-list — which is a silent denial, not an error: `listen` rejects a promise nothing awaits, so the interface keeps drawing off its own timers while every push from the node is dropped. `crates/kols-app/tests/permissions.rs` asserts this list against the commands `app.js` actually calls.

This grants the core default set and two window commands outside it. It grants no plugins, because there are none: everything this client does crosses `kols-api` as an application command, and those are not ACL-gated.
